intro.text: I'm a 20-year-old enthusiastic beginner. I earned my technician degree in software development and testing.

location.title: I currently live in Szeged

passion.title: Coding is my passion
passion.text: I love using my creativity and problem-solving skills in programming. I see it not just as a job, but as a calling. I aim to work in web development and/or game development.

skills.name: Adaptability
skills.title: I like experimenting with new things and developing my knowledge. I learn many programming languages and new methods on my own.

skills.name: Creativity
skills.title: I often include creative, visually striking elements in my projects. The appearance is as important to me as the functionality.

skills.name: Team Player
skills.title: I often work in teams. I enjoy collaborating with others – brainstorming together, sharing tasks, and helping each other reach common goals. I believe a good team is not only faster but also more inspiring.

skills.name: Precision
skills.title: I pay attention to details – code, design, or functionality. I take debugging and fine-tuning seriously.

skills.name: Problem Solving
skills.title: I enjoy facing challenges and finding effective solutions to complex problems. Mistakes are not obstacles but opportunities.
